title: Spicy Thai Tom Yum Soup
description: A classic Thai soup made with a flavorful broth, spicy from chili peppers and lemongrass, and sweet from the addition of tomatoes.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced chilies, lemongrass, and a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant (1-2 minutes).
Add the diced tomatoes, fish balls or tofu, and Thai basil. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the fish balls or tofu are cooked through (3-4 minutes).
Add the som tam and tam sauces. Stir to combine.
Pour in the pomelo juice and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional Thai basil if desired.
